id: propose-path-plan
title: "Propose planned heads for a path (pure computation, not committed)"
description: "Two forms (ADR 0043). FROM THE LABOUR PLAN: omit `charge` and name `shiftId` (with `siteCode`): `proposedHeads` is the `planned_heads` warehouse-planning published for (siteCode, shiftId, pathId) in LabourPlanCommitted (this service keeps a local copy), `resolvedRate` its `rate_units_per_hour`, `rateSource` is `labour-plan` and NO idle-share trim applies; nothing published is 404 labour-plan-not-found, never zero heads. CHARGE-BASED (DEPRECATED, unchanged; removed only by a later ADR once no caller sends a charge): a request with `charge`, even one that also names `shiftId`, works as described below. Neither `charge` nor `shiftId` is 400 missing-charge. Both forms raise ShiftPlanProposed. Computes `heads = ceil(charge / plannedRate)` for one path and raises ShiftPlanProposed for visibility — it persists nothing and commits nothing. A human must still call POST /shift-plans to commit an actual ShiftPlan. This is why the response is 200, not 201: no resource is created. When a high observed idle share (idleness-as-staffing-signal, fed back from labor-performance via `LABOR_PERFORMANCE_MODE=kafka-cache`) is available for this path's task type and exceeds `IDLE_SHARE_TRIM_THRESHOLD` (default 0.30), the computed heads are further trimmed (floored at 1 head minimum) and `trimReason` explains why — fail-open: no idle-share signal available applies no trim."

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/paths/{pathId}/plan-proposals"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>

Two forms (ADR 0043). FROM THE LABOUR PLAN: omit `charge` and name `shiftId` (with `siteCode`): `proposedHeads` is the `planned_heads` warehouse-planning published for (siteCode, shiftId, pathId) in LabourPlanCommitted (this service keeps a local copy), `resolvedRate` its `rate_units_per_hour`, `rateSource` is `labour-plan` and NO idle-share trim applies; nothing published is 404 labour-plan-not-found, never zero heads. CHARGE-BASED (DEPRECATED, unchanged; removed only by a later ADR once no caller sends a charge): a request with `charge`, even one that also names `shiftId`, works as described below. Neither `charge` nor `shiftId` is 400 missing-charge. Both forms raise ShiftPlanProposed. Computes `heads = ceil(charge / plannedRate)` for one path and raises ShiftPlanProposed for visibility — it persists nothing and commits nothing. A human must still call POST /shift-plans to commit an actual ShiftPlan. This is why the response is 200, not 201: no resource is created. When a high observed idle share (idleness-as-staffing-signal, fed back from labor-performance via `LABOR_PERFORMANCE_MODE=kafka-cache`) is available for this path's task type and exceeds `IDLE_SHARE_TRIM_THRESHOLD` (default 0.30), the computed heads are further trimmed (floored at 1 head minimum) and `trimReason` explains why — fail-open: no idle-share signal available applies no trim.
